parsed.name: Coherent 可调谐超快激光器
parsed.description: 这是一类由 Coherent 生产的可调谐超快激光器，能够在一定波长范围内输出激光并进行波长调谐，同时支持群时延色散补偿、快门控制和对准模式。该类设备常用于双光子显微、超快光谱、非线性光学及其他需要可调谐短脉冲激光源的实验。
parsed.description_en: This is a tunable ultrafast laser made by Coherent. It provides laser output over a selectable wavelength range and supports wavelength tuning, group-delay-dispersion compensation, shutter control, and alignment mode. Such systems are commonly used in multiphoton microscopy, ultrafast spectroscopy, nonlinear optics, and other experiments requiring a tunable short-pulse laser source.
